messages:
alex: Heads-up — I just reviewed the API ref PR and found a couple of issues on the /v1/streams endpoint example. The request example uses `auth_token` instead of `api_key`, and the response sample shows `chunk` field but our runtime returns `delta`/`done` fields.

maria: Ugh, thanks for catching. Which PR is this?

alex: PR is #8422 — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8422 :eyes:

jamal: I skimmed it. Looks like two separate things: 1) param name mismatch in the curl example, 2) out-of-date streaming response schema. Both are easy fixes.

sam: I can push a small patch for the curl snippet if you want. Is the correct header `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`?

alex: Yep — we use `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` for hosted API. The example currently has `-H "Authorization: auth_token XYZ"` which is confusing.

maria: For the response, our runtime emits chunk objects like `{ "delta": "text", "done": false }` and a final `{ "done": true }`. The doc's example shows `{ "chunk": "..." }`. We should update the schema and a short note about partial vs final messages.

jamal: Proposed minimal change: update curl example and replace the response block with this verified sample. Also add a one-line note: "Streaming responses return delta objects; final event has `done: true`."

alex: Sample we can paste into the PR: ```json
{
  "id": "stream_abc",
  "events": [
    { "delta": "Hello ", "done": false },
    { "delta": "world", "done": false },
    { "done": true }
  ]
}
```

sam: Looks good. I'll open a follow-up commit in the same PR with the curl fix: ```bash
curl -N \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-stream","input":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams
```

maria: Can we also update the param docs for `streaming` under the schema? It currently documents a boolean `stream` param but our SDK uses `streaming: true`. We should standardize on `streaming` (backend already accepts both via compatibility shim, but docs should show `streaming`).

jamal: Good catch. I'll change the param name in the OpenAPI file and add an alias note: "legacy: `stream` accepted but `streaming` preferred".

alex: After these changes, let's run the docs build and verify the generated examples. @docs-bot can you run a quick preview build for the PR?

docs-bot: Build queued for PR #8422. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-8422--docs.redwood.ai (status: running) :gear:

sam: I pushed the curl snippet commit to the PR (sha: 9f3a2c).

maria: Pushed the OpenAPI param rename + alias note (sha: b1c7de).

jamal: Pushed the response schema update and replaced the example block (sha: 4d9eaa).

alex: Preview looks good, examples now show `delta` objects and the header fix works. Thanks everyone. I'll merge once CI finishes. :+1:

docs-bot: Build completed successfully for PR #8422. Preview: https://deploy-preview-8422--docs.redwood.ai (status: success) :white_check_mark:

maria: Merged at 1767112598. Small follow-up: can we add a line in the migration guide (v1 -> v2) noting the `stream` -> `streaming` pref? Might save confusion.

alex: Good idea — I'll add a short note in `migration.md` after lunch.

sam: Thanks all.
